language_invalid_code: `%s` isn't a supported language. Use `en`, `id` or `jp`.
language_db_error: Couldn't save the language. Try again in a bit.
permission_denied: Only server admins can change the language.
lyrics_not_found: No lyrics found for this song.
filter_changed: Filter set to **%s**. The current song restarts with it.
full_lyrics_not_available: Full lyrics aren't available for this song.
lyrics_not_loaded: Lyrics aren't loaded yet. Open them with the Lyrics button first.
no_favorites: You don't have any favorites yet. Use `/favorite` while a song is playing.
queue_empty_collection: The queue is empty, so there's nothing to save.
no_collections: You don't have any saved playlists.
help_section_playback_value:
`/play <song or link>`: play or queue from YouTube or Spotify
`/pause`, `/resume`
`/skip`: next song
`/previous`: previous song
`/stop`: stop and clear the queue
help_section_queue_value:
`/queue`: show the queue
`/nowplaying`: current song
`/shuffle`: shuffle the queue
`/loop track|song|off`: repeat the whole queue, one song, or nothing
`/exclude <n or link>`: skip a track on every loop, `/include` brings it back
`/top`: most played songs this week
`/playlist create|play <name>`: save or load a playlist
help_section_info_value:
`/favorite`, `/favorites`: save the current song, list saved songs
`/stats`: bot stats (owner only)
`/ping`: latency
stats_owner_only: Only the bot owner can use this.
ytauth_description: If YouTube blocks age-restricted videos or the server's IP, give the bot a `cookies.txt`:
ytauth_step1_value: Use a browser extension like **Get cookies.txt LOCALLY** and export the YouTube cookies of a throwaway account.
ytauth_step2_name: 2. Put the file in the project folder
ytauth_step2_value: Save it as `cookies.txt` in the bot's root folder (`%s`).
ytauth_step3_value: Restart the bot. It picks up `cookies.txt` on its own.
queue_empty_help: The queue is empty. Add something with `/play`.
yt_auth_owner_only: Only the bot owner can use this.
spotify_not_configured: Spotify isn't set up. Add `SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID` and `SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET` to `.env`.
spotify_first_track_error: Couldn't find the playlist's first track on YouTube.
playlist_created: Created playlist **%s**. Add songs with `/playlist add-track %s <song or link>`.
playlist_already_exists: You already have a playlist called **%s**. See it with `/playlist list-tracks name:%s`.
top_empty: Nothing has been played here in this period yet.
loop_song: Loop: song. The current song repeats.
loop_track: Loop: track. The whole queue repeats.
interaction_expired: That button has expired. Use `/play` to start again.
